articles.title: Getting started with NSBiz
articles.summary: Start the free NSBiz in a browser or install it: add your business, try the sample data, learn the menu, and know where your data is kept.
faq: Is the App really free?
Yes. Every Nivesh Sahayak tool is free to use, with no login and no paid version.
Do I need internet?
Only to open it the first time. After that the App and the document makers keep working offline; the data is on your device.

articles.summary: Your NSBiz data stays on your device: data files in your browser or the Windows program, shared by all tools, with backups, auto save and daily copies.

articles.title: Check an IFSC code inside the App
articles.summary: Check an IFSC code before you put bank details on a bill or save a party: bank, branch, address, MICR code, and the new code when a bank has merged.
faq: Does the checker see my account number?
No. You type only the IFSC code. The code is checked in your browser; nothing about your business is sent anywhere.
Can it tell me whether an account number is right?
No. Only the bank can. When you pay by NEFT or RTGS, your bank shows the account holder's name before you confirm: read it every time.
How current is the list?
The date of the data is shown under every result. A branch opened after that date may be missing.

articles.title: Find or check a PIN code inside the App

faq: Where does the list come from?
From India Post's all-India PIN code directory. The date the copy was taken is shown under the result.
Does the PIN code finder show advertisements?
No. Inside the App there are none.

faq: Does it use my location?
No. You type both places. Nothing is asked from your device.
Does the distance calculator show advertisements?
No. Inside the App there are none.

faq: Are masters shared between my businesses?
Parties, items and units are shared by every business on this device, as in My data. Voucher types (number series) and banks are kept per business.
Is this the same as My data?
Yes, the same records: My data on my.niveshsahayak.in shows them too, with import and export to Excel.

Where do I see who cancelled it and why?

articles.title: GST returns: official forms, the portal JSON and the department's Excel tools
articles.card: GST returns: official forms, JSON and the department's Excel tools
articles.summary: See GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B and CMP-08 in the official layout inside NSBiz, download the GSTR-3B JSON and fill the GST department's own Excel tools.
faq: Does NSBiz file my return?
No. It prepares the form, the JSON and the filled Excel tool. You upload and file on the GST portal with your own login.
Do I need internet to fill a tool?
Only the first time, to download the tool from gst.gov.in. After that NSBiz uses the copy it keeps on this device.
What happens when the department releases a new version?
Download it from gst.gov.in and press Change template file beside the button. The new one is kept from then on.

articles.title: GST stock forms: ITC-01, ITC-03 and GSTR-10
articles.card: GST stock forms: ITC-01, ITC-03, GSTR-10
articles.summary: Work out the GST credit on your stock in hand for ITC-01, ITC-03 or GSTR-10 in NSBiz, traced to purchase bills, and fill or copy into the official tools.
faq: Is the original tool changed?
No. Excel fills a copy and saves it under a new name; the downloaded tool is kept as it is for next time.
Why is a row missing from ITC-01?
ITC-01 lists invoices only. Goods made here, opening stock and capital goods are left out of that tool.

articles.title: GST TDS deducted (GSTR-7) and ITC distribution (GSTR-6)
articles.summary: Record GST TDS at 2% on contracts above Rs 2.5 lakh for GSTR-7, split input service credit between branches for GSTR-6, and fill both offline tools.
faq: Can I delete a GST TDS entry?
Yes, with Delete on its row in the table.
Where are the filled files?
In Downloads, named with your GSTIN, GSTR7 or GSTR6, and the month. With auto save to a folder on, also in NSBiz › GST Returns.

articles.title: TCS on sale bills, Form 127 and the statement Excel
articles.card: TCS on sales, Form 127 and the TDS/TCS statement Excel
articles.summary: Collect TCS on a sale bill or keep the buyer's Form 127, then get the quarterly Form 143 and TDS statements as one Excel with the official codes in NSBiz.
faq: Does every sale need TCS now?
No. Only the sales the TCS box lists (section 394). Other goods have no TCS; the old ₹50 lakh rule is gone.
Where is the Form 127 noted?
On the bill (the printed line), and in the Form 143 Excel as a row with remark B and no tax.

articles.title: What's new in NSBiz, and how updates reach you
articles.summary: See every change to NSBiz on the What's new page, filter it by New, Better, Fixed or area, and learn how the App and the Windows program update.
faq: Do I lose anything when the App updates?
No. An update changes the App's own files only. Your businesses, bills and settings stay where they are.
Can I stay on an older version?
No. The App in the browser always uses the newest version, so everyone has the latest fixes.
